# LayoutSnapshotSchema

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Schema version emitted in every snapshot, so consumers can feature-detect. v2 adds per-node `NodeAccessibility` (`A11y`) and `SnapshotMeta` (`Meta`); v3 adds `SourceId`; v4 adds per-node `NodePaint` (`Paint`) and the page backdrop facts on `PageSize`. Consumers that ignore unknown fields remain compatible.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`Version`](#version): The current snapshot schema version (4).
